def semantics(base,documents,expected):
    found={};terms={'suppress':{},'add':{}}
    for document in documents:
        need(document['schema']=='terminal-repair/1','COMMON_BASIS_ORDINARY_TERMINAL_SCHEMA')
        for value in document['source_evidence']:
            reference=value['reference']
            if reference not in expected:continue
            need(value['sha256']==expected[reference],'COMMON_BASIS_DECLARED_FACT_COMPILER')
            found[reference]=value['sha256']
        for name in terms:
            for value in document[name]:
                key=value['session'],value['security_id']
                need(key not in terms[name] or terms[name][key]==value,'COMMON_BASIS_NO_CONFLICTING_TERM')
                terms[name][key]=value
    need(set(found)==set(expected),'COMMON_BASIS_ALL_FACTS_PRESENT')
    value={'schema':'research.system-campaign-common-semantic-basis/1',
        'frozen_bundle_sha256':base['bundle_sha256'],'frozen_archive_sha256':base['archive_sha256'],
        'declared_fact_compilers':found,
        **{name:[rows[k] for k in sorted(rows)] for name,rows in terms.items()}}
    return value


def basis(evidence,cp):
    names={CATALOG_REF:Path('/driver/system-campaign-factual-catalog.json'),
        COMPILER_REF:Path('/driver/system_campaign_facts.py'),
        HYDRATED_REF:evidence/'hydrated-factual-catalog.json',
        ADDITIONAL:Path('/driver/system-campaign-additional-terminal-facts.json'),
        ADDITIONAL_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_terminal_facts.py'),
        ADDITIONAL_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-additional-terminal-catalog.json',
        WINTER:Path('/driver/system-campaign-corrected-winter-facts.json'),
        WINTER_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_winter_facts.py'),
        WINTER_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-corrected-winter-cash-catalog.json',
        SPRING:Path('/driver/system-campaign-spring-terminal-facts.json'),
        SPRING_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_spring_facts.py'),
        SPRING_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-spring-terminal-catalog.json',
        FOLLOWUP:Path('/driver/system-campaign-followup-terminal-facts.json'),
        FOLLOWUP_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_followup_facts.py'),
        FOLLOWUP_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-followup-terminal-catalog.json',
        TGI:Path('/driver/system-campaign-tgi-cash-facts.json'),
        TGI_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_tgi_facts.py'),
        TGI_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-tgi-cash-catalog.json',
        MIDYEAR:Path('/driver/system-campaign-midyear-terminal-facts.json'),
        MIDYEAR_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_midyear_facts.py'),
        MIDYEAR_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-midyear-terminal-catalog.json',
        LATE:Path('/driver/system-campaign-late-terminal-facts.json'),
        LATE_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_late_facts.py'),
        LATE_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-late-terminal-catalog.json',
        YEAREND:Path('/driver/system-campaign-yearend-terminal-facts.json'),
        YEAREND_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_yearend_facts.py'),
        YEAREND_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-yearend-terminal-catalog.json',
        FOLLOWON:Path('/driver/system-campaign-followon-terminal-facts.json'),
        FOLLOWON_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_followon_facts.py'),
        FOLLOWON_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-followon-terminal-catalog.json',
        PARSLEY:Path('/driver/system-campaign-parsley-terminal-facts.json'),
        PARSLEY_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_parsley_facts.py'),
        PARSLEY_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-parsley-terminal-catalog.json',
        EARLY2019:Path('/driver/system-campaign-early2019-terminal-facts.json'),
        EARLY2019_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_early2019_facts.py'),
        EARLY2019_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-early2019-terminal-catalog.json',
        DISTRIBUTION:Path('/driver/system-campaign-distribution-facts.json'),
        DISTRIBUTION_COMPILER:Path('/driver/system_campaign_distribution_facts.py'),
        DISTRIBUTION_HYDRATED:evidence/'hydrated-distribution-catalog.json'}
    need(all(p.is_file() for p in names.values()),'COMMON_BASIS_ACTUAL_COMPLETE_FACT_FILES')
    expected={k:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k,p in names.items()};documents=[]
    for spec in cp['repairs']:
        raw=(evidence/'book/repairs'/spec['filename']).read_bytes()
        need(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==spec['sha256'],'COMMON_BASIS_EXACT_REPAIR_ARCHIVE')
        documents.append(json.loads(raw))
    value=semantics(cp['base'],documents,expected)
    return digest(value),value

"""Exact own pre-event suffixes with unchanged canonical financial machinery."""
import argparse,json
from pathlib import Path
from full_system_core import arguments,hosted
from full_system_benchmark import need,save
from system_campaign_acceleration import Execution
from system_campaign_facts import FactualInputs,sha
from system_campaign_factual_run import preflight,correlation_seed,SeededObservation,preserve_tails,review as canonical_review
from system_campaign_early2019_run import retained_eleven
from system_campaign_early2019_facts import Early2019Facts
from system_campaign_distribution_facts import DistributionFacts,CATALOG
from system_campaign_own_origin import qualify as qualify_origin


def retained_twelve(refs,old,out,driver=Path('/driver')):
    retained_eleven(refs,old,out,driver)
    for suffix,path in (
        ('terminal-catalog',driver/'system-campaign-early2019-terminal-facts.json'),
        ('terminal-compiler',driver/'system_campaign_early2019_facts.py'),
        ('private-terminal-catalog',old/'hydrated-early2019-terminal-catalog.json')):
        ref='research:system-optimization-002/early2019-'+suffix+'/1'
        need(path.is_file() and [v['sha256'] for v in refs if v['reference']==ref]==[sha(path.read_bytes())],
             'DISTRIBUTION_EXACT_TWELVE_PRIOR_COMPONENTS')
    name='hydrated-early2019-terminal-catalog.json';(out/name).write_bytes((old/name).read_bytes())


def run(out,old,spec):
    hosted()
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding import backtest,journal
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding.repair import load_repair
    extra=spec['arm']=='P04';cp=preflight(spec,old,out,before='2019-01-25' if extra else '2019-04-09')
    need(spec['arm'] in ('P01','P02','P04','P07') and cp['source_cursor']==('2018-12-31' if extra else '2019-03-29'),
         'DISTRIBUTION_OWN_EXACT_PRE_EVENT_BOUNDARY')
    need(json.loads((old/'source-bindings.json').read_bytes())['parameters']['family']=='CORE',
         'DISTRIBUTION_UNCHANGED_CORE_PARAMETERS')
    qualify_origin(out,cp,out/'own-origin-qualification.json');refs=[]
    for d in cp['repairs']:
        raw=(old/'book/repairs'/d['filename']).read_bytes();need(sha(raw)==d['sha256'],'DISTRIBUTION_OLD_REPAIR_BYTES')
        refs.extend(json.loads(raw)['source_evidence'])
    need(not any(v['reference']==CATALOG for v in refs),'DISTRIBUTION_NO_DUPLICATE_INPUT')
    (retained_eleven if extra else retained_twelve)(refs,old,out)
    v1=FactualInputs('/driver/system-campaign-factual-catalog.json');v1.hydrate(out/'independent-v1-hydration.json')
    need(sha((out/'independent-v1-hydration.json').read_bytes())==sha((out/'hydrated-factual-catalog.json').read_bytes()),
         'DISTRIBUTION_IDENTICAL_V1_HYDRATION')
    facts=DistributionFacts('/driver/system-campaign-distribution-facts.json')
    facts.hydrate(out/'hydrated-distribution-catalog.json');overlay=out/'distribution-input-overlay.json';loaded=facts.overlay(cp,overlay)
    early=None
    if extra:
        early=Early2019Facts('/driver/system-campaign-early2019-terminal-facts.json')
        early.hydrate(out/'hydrated-early2019-terminal-catalog.json');path=out/'early2019-component.json';early.overlay(cp,path)
        merged=json.loads(overlay.read_bytes());other=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        need(merged['predecessor_checkpoint_sha256']==other['predecessor_checkpoint_sha256'],'DISTRIBUTION_SAME_OWN_PREDECESSOR')
        for name in ('source_evidence','suppress','add'):merged[name]+=other[name]
        save(overlay,merged);loaded=load_repair(overlay,resume_session=cp['source_cursor'],predecessor_checkpoint_sha256=cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'])
    need(facts._bound(loaded),'DISTRIBUTION_FINAL_OWN_COMPOUND_BINDING')
    for cursor,predecessor in ((cp['source_cursor'],'0'*64),(loaded.earliest_affected_session,cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'])):
        try:load_repair(overlay,resume_session=cursor,predecessor_checkpoint_sha256=predecessor)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise ValueError('REFUSED_DISTRIBUTION_TERMINAL_PARSER_FALSIFIER')
    save(out/'distribution-overlay-admission.json',{'own_predecessor':cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'],
        'overlay_sha256':loaded.sha256,'prior_components_retained_exactly':11 if extra else 12,
        'components_added':2 if extra else 1,'wrong_predecessor_and_consumed_terminal_refused':True,
        'compound_first_spin_boundary':'2019-04-09','source_conversion':False,'new_origin':False})
    observer=SeededObservation(out/'correlation-inputs.jsonl.gz',correlation_seed(old,cp))
    args=arguments(out/'book',True);args[args.index('--policy')+1]=cp['base']['policy']
    with v1,facts:
        facts.qualify(loaded,out/'distribution-input-qualification.json')
        if early:early.qualify(loaded,out/'early2019-input-qualification.json')
        with observer:
            with Execution('FAST',signal_closes=1) as execution:code=backtest.main(args+['--repair-overlay',str(overlay)])
    save(out/'acceleration-proof.json',execution.proof());save(out/'correlation-capture-proof.json',observer.proof())
    save(out/'recovered-tail-proof.json',preserve_tails(out/'book',json.loads((out/'factual-preflight.json').read_bytes())))
    current=journal.read_checkpoint(out/'book/checkpoint.json.gz')
    save(out/'distribution-outcome.json',{'session':current['source_cursor'],'completed':current['completed'],
        'complete':current['source_cursor']==backtest.END and current['completed']==2156,
        'new_origin':False,'financial_source_changed':False,'production_contacted':False})
    need(code==0,'DISTRIBUTION_REFUSED_PREFIX_PRESERVED')


def review(out,evidence,old,spec):
    canonical_review(out,evidence,old,spec)
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding import journal
    selected=journal.read_checkpoint(old/spec['selected_checkpoint'])
    qualify_origin(evidence,selected,out/'independent-own-origin-qualification.json')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--mode',choices=('economic','review'),required=True);p.add_argument('--spec',type=Path,required=True)
    a=p.parse_args();hosted();spec=json.loads(a.spec.read_bytes())
    if a.mode=='economic':run(Path('/out'),Path('/old'),spec)
    else:review(Path('/out'),Path('/evidence'),Path('/old'),spec)

"""GitHub-hosted ONLY: authenticate an encrypted branch, never a local replay."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,tarfile,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher,algorithms,modes
from full_system_benchmark import need
from probe import check_context
from seal import MAGIC,safe_name,sha256_file


def hosted_destination(root):
    # This guard runs before any filesystem creation, credential or network use.
    check_context(os.environ)
    root=Path(root).resolve();temp=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']).resolve()
    need(os.name=='posix' and str(temp)=='/home/runner/work/_temp'
         and root.parent==temp and root.name.startswith('campaign-factual-transfer-')
         and shutil.disk_usage(temp).free>=12*1024**3,'HOSTED_FACTUAL_DESTINATION_CAPACITY')
    return root


def authenticate(z,asset,key):
    h=hashlib.sha256();size=0;tail=b''
    with z.open(asset['name']) as source:
        header=source.read(20);need(header.startswith(MAGIC) and len(header)==20,'FACTUAL_CIPHER_HEADER')
        h.update(header);size=20
        dec=Cipher(algorithms.AES256(key),modes.GCM(header[-12:])).decryptor();dec.authenticate_additional_data(header)
        while chunk:=source.read(1024**2):
            h.update(chunk);size+=len(chunk);raw=tail+chunk
            if len(raw)>16:dec.update(raw[:-16]);tail=raw[-16:]
            else:tail=raw
        dec.finalize_with_tag(tail)
    need(size==asset['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==asset['sha256'],'FACTUAL_CIPHER_LENGTH_HASH_GCM')
    return header,tail


class AuthenticatedStream:
    def __init__(self,source,asset,key,header,tag):
        need(source.read(20)==header,'FACTUAL_CIPHER_SAME_HEADER')
        self.source,self.left,self.tag,self.done=source,asset['bytes']-36,tag,False
        self.dec=Cipher(algorithms.AES256(key),modes.GCM(header[-12:],tag)).decryptor()
        self.dec.authenticate_additional_data(header)
    def read(self,n=-1):
        if n==0 or self.done:return b''
        if self.left:
            raw=self.source.read(min(self.left,n if n>0 else 1024**2));need(bool(raw),'FACTUAL_CIPHER_NOT_TRUNCATED')
            self.left-=len(raw);return self.dec.update(raw)
        need(self.source.read(16)==self.tag and self.source.read(1)==b'','FACTUAL_CIPHER_FOOTER')
        self.dec.finalize();self.done=True;return b''


def archive_bound(spec,limit):
    need(type(limit) is int and limit in (256*1024**2,512*1024**2,1024**3),
         'FACTUAL_DECLARED_ARCHIVE_LIMIT')
    need(type(spec['zip_bytes']) is int and 0<spec['zip_bytes']<limit,'FACTUAL_ENCRYPTED_DOWNLOAD_BOUND')


def admit(spec,root,key,*,max_zip_bytes=256*1024**2):
    root=hosted_destination(root);archive_bound(spec,max_zip_bytes);root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    archive=root/'predecessor.zip'
    with archive.open('xb') as out:
        subprocess.run(['gh','api',f"repos/flabber1835/stocker/actions/artifacts/{spec['artifact_id']}/zip"],stdout=out,check=True,timeout=180)
    need(archive.stat().st_size==spec['zip_bytes'] and sha256_file(archive)==spec['zip_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_ZIP')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        raw=z.read(spec['receipt_name']);need(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==spec['receipt_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_RECEIPT')
        r=json.loads(raw);asset=r['encrypted_output']
        need(r['schema']==spec['receipt_schema'] and int(r['run_id'])==spec['run_id'] and r['head']==spec['head']
             and r['arm']==spec['arm'] and asset==spec['encrypted_output'] and not r['production_contacted']
             and r['protocol_sha256']==spec['protocol_sha256'] and r['request_sha256']==spec['request_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_SCOPE')
        need(set(z.namelist())=={spec['receipt_name'],'full-core-staging.json',asset['name']}
             and z.getinfo(asset['name']).file_size==asset['bytes'],'FACTUAL_OLD_ZIP_MEMBERS')
        header,tag=authenticate(z,asset,key)  # Authenticate before parsing plaintext.
        dest=root/'admitted';dest.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        with z.open(asset['name']) as source:
            plain=AuthenticatedStream(source,asset,key,header,tag)
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=plain,mode='r|gz') as tar:
                first=tar.next();need(first.name=='manifest.json' and first.isfile() and first.size<2*1024**2,'FACTUAL_OLD_MANIFEST')
                raw=tar.extractfile(first).read();need(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==asset['manifest_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_MANIFEST_HASH')
                m=json.loads(raw)
                need(m['schema']=='research.full-system-output/1' and m['stage']==spec['stage'] and m['arm']==spec['arm']
                     and int(m['run_id'])==spec['run_id'] and m['head']==spec['head']
                     and m['request_sha256']==spec['request_sha256'] and m['protocol_sha256']==spec['protocol_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_MANIFEST_BINDINGS')
                inventory=m['members'];need(len(inventory)<5000 and sum(v['bytes'] for v in inventory.values())<1024**3,'FACTUAL_PLAINTEXT_BOUND')
                seen=set()
                while item:=tar.next():
                    safe_name(item.name);need(item.isfile() and item.name in inventory and item.name not in seen,'FACTUAL_OLD_MEMBER')
                    seen.add(item.name);expected=inventory[item.name];need(item.size==expected['bytes'],'FACTUAL_OLD_MEMBER_LENGTH')
                    target=dest/item.name;need(target.resolve().is_relative_to(dest),'FACTUAL_HOSTED_EXTRACTION_BOUNDARY')
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                    with tar.extractfile(item) as src,target.open('xb') as out:shutil.copyfileobj(src,out,length=1024**2)
                    os.chmod(target,0o600);need(sha256_file(target)==expected['sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_MEMBER_HASH')
                need(seen==set(inventory),'FACTUAL_OLD_COMPLETE_INVENTORY')
            while plain.read(1024**2):pass
    for n,e in spec['inspections'].items():
        need(sha256_file(dest/n)==(e['sha256'] or inventory[n]['sha256']),'FACTUAL_OLD_STOP_BYTES');v=json.loads((dest/n).read_bytes());h=v['HostConfig']
        need(v['Name']==e['name'] and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',v['Id']) is not None and (e['id'] is None or v['Id']==e['id']) and not v['State']['Running'] and not v['State']['OOMKilled']
             and v['State']['ExitCode']==e['exit_code'],'FACTUAL_OLD_ACTUAL_STOP')
        need(v['Image']=='sha256:1b449754a48473e4737fc34f3f51ae0b4226d5e84540dea54115d4693142ed9d'
             and h['NetworkMode']=='none' and h['Memory']==h['MemorySwap']==8*1024**3 and h['NanoCpus']==2000000000
             and h['ReadonlyRootfs'] and h['PidsLimit']==64 and h['CapDrop']==['ALL']
             and any(x.startswith('no-new-privileges') for x in h['SecurityOpt']),'FACTUAL_OLD_FENCES')
        mounts={x['Destination']:x for x in v['Mounts'] if x['Type']=='bind'}
        need(mounts['/out']['RW'] and all(not x['RW'] for k,x in mounts.items() if k!='/out'),'FACTUAL_OLD_INPUT_MOUNTS')
    need(sha256_file(dest/'source-bindings.json')==spec['source_binding_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_SOURCE_REVIEW')
    if spec.get('unadvanced_qualification_failure'):
        prove_unadvanced(spec,inventory,dest)
    elif spec.get('review_refusal'):
        # Admission of the immutable evidence is not financial admission.
        # The corrected hosted preflight must independently review its entire
        # current committed branch before choosing or advancing a predecessor.
        prove_review_refusal(spec,inventory,dest)
    else:
        need(sha256_file(dest/'core-review.json')==spec['review_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_REVIEW_BYTES')
    p=dest/spec['selected_checkpoint'];need(sha256_file(p)==spec['selected_file']['sha256'],'FACTUAL_SELECTED_GZIP')
    cp=json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes()))
    need(cp['sha256']==spec['outer_sha256'] and cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256']==spec['inner_sha256']
         and cp['run']['state_sha256']==spec['state_sha256'] and cp['run']['input_sha256']==spec['input_sha256']
         and cp['base']==spec['base'] and cp['source_cursor']==spec['selected_session']
         and cp['journals']==spec['journals'] and cp['repairs']==spec['repairs'],'FACTUAL_SELECTED_BINDINGS')
    for n,c in cp['journals'].items():
        with (dest/f'book/{n}.jsonl').open('rb') as f:raw=f.read(c['bytes'])
        need(len(raw)==c['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==c['prefix_sha256'],'FACTUAL_SELECTED_PREFIX')
    return dest


def prove_review_refusal(spec,inventory,root):
    need(spec['review_refusal']=='CONVERSION_IDENTITY_REVIEW' and
         spec['receipt_schema']=='research.system-campaign-factual-suffix-receipt/1',
         'FACTUAL_DECLARED_REVIEW_ONLY_REFUSAL')
    log=root/'independent-review-stop/worker.log'
    need(sha256_file(log)==spec['review_log_sha256'] and
         'ValueError: REFUSED_LEDGER_SHARES' in log.read_text() and
         'core-review.json' not in inventory,'FACTUAL_EXACT_REVIEW_REFUSAL_BYTES')
    need(spec['inspections']['independent-review-stop/worker-inspect.json']['exit_code']==1,
         'FACTUAL_ACTUAL_FAILED_REVIEW_STOP')


def prove_unadvanced(spec,inventory,root):
    """Refuse any unexpected progress instead of adopting an earlier checkpoint."""
    kind=spec.get('unadvanced_failure_kind','QUALIFIER_PARTIAL_PACKET')
    if kind=='PROOF_BUFFER_CONSTRUCTOR':
        prove_unadvanced_buffer_constructor(spec,inventory,root);return
    need(kind in ('QUALIFIER_PARTIAL_PACKET','RESUME_REPAIR_PERMISSION'),'FACTUAL_DECLARED_UNADVANCED_FAILURE')
    prefix=spec.get('immutable_old_branch_prefix','lineage/old-branch/')
    need(prefix in ('lineage/old-branch/','lineage/old-branch/lineage/old-branch/'),'FACTUAL_DECLARED_IMMUTABLE_BRANCH')
    nested={n[len(prefix):]:v for n,v in inventory.items() if n.startswith(prefix)}
    digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(nested,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()

"""Hosted canonical factual suffix of each own retained pre-event checkpoint."""
import argparse,gzip,json,os,shutil,zipfile
from contextlib import nullcontext
from dataclasses import asdict,replace
from pathlib import Path
from full_system_core import arguments,hosted
from full_system_benchmark import need,save
from system_campaign_acceleration import Execution
from system_campaign_facts import FactualInputs,digest,sha
from system_campaign_observe import Observation
from system_campaign_readonly import reader,review as readonly_review


def copy_repair_archive(old,book):
    source=old/'book/repairs';target=book/'repairs'
    if not source.exists():return
    need(target.resolve().parent==book.resolve() and target.resolve()!=source.resolve(),'FACTUAL_DISJOINT_REPAIR_ARCHIVE')
    shutil.copytree(source,target)
    # Change only the new disjoint output directory, never retained file bytes
    # or the original RO branch. Canonical resume must archive its new overlay.
    os.chmod(target,0o700)


def preflight(spec,old,out,*,before='2017-08-09'):
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding import backtest,runtime,journal
    from research.pooled_input_support.bundle import axis
    readonly_review(old/'book',out/'old-branch-canonical-review.json')
    cp=journal.read_checkpoint(old/spec['selected_checkpoint']);full=axis()
    wanted=full[full.index(backtest.START)-425:full.index(backtest.END)+1]
    backtest.validate_checkpoint(cp,cp['base'],wanted)
    need(cp['base']['sources']==backtest.source_files() and cp['sha256']==spec['outer_sha256']
         and cp['source_cursor']==spec['selected_session']<before,'FACTUAL_OWN_SOURCE_CURSOR')
    restored=runtime.restore(cp['run'],policy=cp['base']['policy'],input_sha256=backtest.input_hash(cp['base'],cp['repairs']))
    need(runtime.checkpoint(restored)==cp['run'],'FACTUAL_OWN_CANONICAL_ROUNDTRIP')
    j=reader(journal.Journal,old/'book',journal.STREAMS)
    try:j.verify(cp['journals'])
    finally:j.close()
    book=out/'book';book.mkdir();(book/'predecessor-checkpoints').mkdir()
    shutil.copyfile(old/'book/identity.json',book/'identity.json')
    for target in (book/'checkpoint.json.gz',book/'predecessor-checkpoints'/(cp['sha256']+'.json.gz')):
        shutil.copyfile(old/spec['selected_checkpoint'],target)
    copy_repair_archive(old,book)
    tails={}
    for n,c in cp['journals'].items():
        raw=(old/f'book/{n}.jsonl').read_bytes();(book/f'{n}.jsonl').write_bytes(raw);tail=raw[c['bytes']:]
        tails[n]={'bytes':len(tail),'sha256':sha(tail)}
    save(out/'factual-preflight.json',{'canonical_roundtrip':True,'all_old_checkpoints_and_prefixes_verified':True,
         'selected_outer_sha256':cp['sha256'],'selected_inner_sha256':cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'],
         'source_conversion':False,'fresh_origin':False,'next_session':wanted[wanted.index(cp['source_cursor'])+1],
         'old_branch_mounted_read_only':str(old),'tails_to_preserve':tails})
    return cp


def correlation_seed(old,cp):
    capture=old/'correlation-inputs.jsonl.gz'
    if not capture.exists():capture=old/'lineage/old-branch/correlation-inputs.jsonl.gz'
    if not capture.exists():return []
    financial={}
    for n in ('formation','daily'):
        with (old/f'book/{n}.jsonl').open('rb') as f:
            for raw in f.read(cp['journals'][n]['bytes']).splitlines():
                r=json.loads(raw);financial[r['session']]=r['state_sha256']
    chain=digest('system-optimization-002/raw-correlation/1');rows=[]
    with gzip.open(capture,'rb') as f:
        for raw in f:
            r=json.loads(raw)
            if r['session']>cp['source_cursor']:break
            committed=r.pop('chain_sha256');chain=digest({'previous':chain,'record':r})
            need(chain==committed and financial[r['session']]==r['next_state_sha256'],'FACTUAL_OLD_CORRELATION_PREFIX');rows.append(raw)
    need(len(rows)==len(financial),'FACTUAL_OLD_CORRELATION_AXIS')
    if rows:need(json.loads(rows[-1])['next_state_sha256']==cp['run']['state_sha256'],'FACTUAL_CORRELATION_SELECTED_STATE')
    return rows


class SeededObservation(Observation):
    def __init__(self,path,rows):super().__init__(path);self.seed=rows
    def __enter__(self):
        super().__enter__()
        for raw in self.seed:self.stream.write(raw)
        if self.seed:
            self.rows=len(self.seed);self.chain=json.loads(self.seed[-1])['chain_sha256'];self.stream.flush();os.fsync(self.stream.fileno())
        return self


def preserve_tails(book,proof):
    result={}
    for n,e in proof['tails_to_preserve'].items():
        if e['bytes']:
            matches=[p for p in book.glob(f'interrupted-{n}-*.jsonl') if p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and sha(p.read_bytes())==e['sha256']]
            need(len(matches)==1,'FACTUAL_EXACT_RECOVERED_TAIL');result[n]={'path':matches[0].name,**e}
        else:result[n]=e
    return result


def qualify_inputs(catalog,loaded,output):
    """Use actual frozen native rows/quotes, without advancing a financial session."""
    from research.pooled_input_support import inputs
    from research.pooled_input_support.adapter import Packet
    from research.bounded_20y.run import vendor,distributions
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding import backtest
    actions=inputs.load_actions(Path('/frozen/bundle'))
    with zipfile.ZipFile('/frozen/archive/corpus.zip') as archive:
        spins=distributions(inputs._archive_rows(archive,'actions.csv.gz'))
        bars=tuple(vendor(r) for r in inputs._archive_rows(archive,'observations-2017.csv.gz')
                   if r['session']=='2017-10-02' and r['security_id'] in ('234488913323173693','285304847559167677'))
    original=Packet('2017-10-02',bars,{},{},1.,{},tuple(actions.terminal.get('2017-10-02',())),tuple(spins.get('2017-10-02',())))
    before=digest(asdict(original));changed=backtest.apply_repair(original,loaded)
    need(digest(asdict(original))==before,'FACTUAL_ORIGINAL_PACKET_UNCHANGED')
    fnf=[r for r in changed.spins if r.parent_security_id=='234488913323173693']
    need(len(fnf)==1 and asdict(fnf[0])==catalog.catalog['fnf']['added'],'FACTUAL_ACTUAL_TYPED_SPIN')
    parent,=[b for b in changed.bars if b.security_id=='234488913323173693']
    need(parent.dividend_per_share==0. and all(asdict(b)==asdict(c) for b,c in zip(original.bars,changed.bars)
         if b.security_id!=parent.security_id),'FACTUAL_NO_DUPLICATE_CASH_OR_OTHER_QUOTE_CHANGE')
    bad_packets=(replace(original,spins=tuple(s for s in original.spins if s.source_row_id!=catalog.catalog['fnf']['native'][0]['source_row_id'])),
                 replace(original,bars=tuple(replace(b,raw_open=b.raw_open+.01) if b.security_id==parent.security_id else b for b in original.bars)))
    for bad in bad_packets:
        try:backtest.apply_repair(bad,loaded)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise ValueError('REFUSED_FACTUAL_NATIVE_SOURCE_FALSIFIER')
    for item in catalog.catalog['terms']:
        for day in {item['native']['session'],item['added']['session']}:
            packet=Packet(day,(),{},{},1.,{},tuple(actions.terminal.get(day,())),())
            # This probe intentionally has only terminal data. Actual complete
            # packets above and every financial packet use the full wrapper.
            fixed=catalog.original(packet,loaded);matches=[t for t in fixed.terminal if t.security_id==item['native']['security_id']]
            if day==item['added']['session']:
                need(len(matches)==1 and asdict(matches[0])==item['added'] and matches[0].completeness(1)[0],'FACTUAL_ACTUAL_TERM_REPLACEMENT')
            else:need(not matches,'FACTUAL_ACTUAL_NATIVE_SUPPRESSION')
    save(output,{'actual_frozen_native_terms':[v['ticker'] for v in catalog.catalog['terms']],
         'actual_fnf_source_rows_and_bars':True,'typed_spin_and_cash_proxy_suppression':True,
         'source_row_and_quote_falsifiers':True,'original_packet_unchanged':True,'financial_sessions_advanced':0})


def run(out,old,spec):
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding import backtest,journal
    cp=preflight(spec,old,out);catalog=FactualInputs('/driver/system-campaign-factual-catalog.json')
    need(catalog.catalog['archive_sha256']==cp['base']['archive_sha256'],'FACTUAL_FROZEN_ARCHIVE_BINDING')
    catalog.hydrate(out/'hydrated-factual-catalog.json')
    origin_path=old/'campaign-own-facts.json'
    if not origin_path.exists():origin_path=old/'lineage/old-branch/campaign-own-facts.json'
    origin=json.loads(origin_path.read_bytes()) if not cp['repairs'] else None
    overlay=out/'common-factual-overlay.json';loaded=catalog.overlay(cp,overlay,origin)
    from research.pooled_vacancy_funding.repair import load_repair
    for cursor,predecessor in ((cp['source_cursor'],'0'*64),('2017-08-09',cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'])):
        try:load_repair(overlay,resume_session=cursor,predecessor_checkpoint_sha256=predecessor)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise ValueError('REFUSED_FACTUAL_PARSER_FALSIFIER')
    save(out/'factual-overlay-admission.json',{'overlay_sha256':loaded.sha256,'catalog_sha256':catalog.catalog_sha,
         'compiler_sha256':catalog.compiler_sha,'own_predecessor':cp['run']['checkpoint_sha256'],
         'wrong_predecessor_refused':True,'consumed_session_refused':True,'financial_source_changed':False})
    p=json.loads((old/'source-bindings.json').read_bytes()).get('parameters',{});family=p.get('family','CORE')
    keep=p['v_horizon'] if family=='V' else 21 if family=='C' else 1
    observer=SeededObservation(out/'correlation-inputs.jsonl.gz',correlation_seed(old,cp)) if spec['arm'].startswith('P') else None
    args=arguments(out/'book',True);args[args.index('--policy')+1]=cp['base']['policy']
    with catalog:
        qualify_inputs(catalog,loaded,out/'factual-input-qualification.json')
        with observer if observer is not None else nullcontext():
            with Execution('REFERENCE' if spec['arm']=='B0' else 'FAST',signal_closes=keep) as execution:
                code=backtest.main(args+['--repair-overlay',str(overlay)])
    save(out/'acceleration-proof.json',execution.proof())
    if observer is not None:save(out/'correlation-capture-proof.json',observer.proof())
    save(out/'recovered-tail-proof.json',preserve_tails(out/'book',json.loads((out/'factual-preflight.json').read_bytes())))
    current=journal.read_checkpoint(out/'book/checkpoint.json.gz')
    save(out/'factual-outcome.json',{'session':current['source_cursor'],'completed':current['completed'],
         'complete':current['source_cursor']==backtest.END and current['completed']==2156,
         'source_conversion':False,'fresh_origin':False,'production_contacted':False})
    need(code==0,'FACTUAL_SUFFIX_REFUSED_PREFIX_PRESERVED')


def review(out,evidence,old,spec):
    readonly_review(evidence/'book',out/'core-review.json')
    proof=json.loads((evidence/'factual-preflight.json').read_bytes())
    save(out/'reviewed-recovered-tail-proof.json',preserve_tails(evidence/'book',proof))
    selected=evidence/'book/predecessor-checkpoints'/(spec['outer_sha256']+'.json.gz')
    need(sha(selected.read_bytes())==spec['selected_file']['sha256'],'FACTUAL_EXACT_OLD_GZIP')
    if spec['arm'].startswith('P'):verify_correlation(evidence)
    save(out/'factual-lineage-review.json',{'old_branch_canonical_checks_reused_from_exact_preflight':True,
         'exact_selected_gzip_old_prefixes_and_recovered_tails':True,'source_conversion':False,'production_contacted':False})


def verify_correlation(root):
    cp=json.loads(gzip.decompress((root/'book/checkpoint.json.gz').read_bytes()));financial={}
    for n in ('formation','daily'):
        with (root/f'book/{n}.jsonl').open('rb') as f:
            for raw in f.read(cp['journals'][n]['bytes']).splitlines():
                r=json.loads(raw);financial[r['session']]=r['state_sha256']
    chain=digest('system-optimization-002/raw-correlation/1');seen=[]
    with gzip.open(root/'correlation-inputs.jsonl.gz','rb') as f:
        for raw in f:
            r=json.loads(raw);committed=r.pop('chain_sha256');chain=digest({'previous':chain,'record':r})
            need(chain==committed,'FACTUAL_CORRELATION_CHAIN')
            if r['session']<=cp['source_cursor']:
                need(financial[r['session']]==r['next_state_sha256'],'FACTUAL_CORRELATION_ACTUAL_STATE');seen.append(r['session'])
    need(seen==sorted(financial),'FACTUAL_CORRELATION_COMMITTED_AXIS')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--mode',choices=('economic','review'),required=True);p.add_argument('--spec',type=Path,required=True)
    a=p.parse_args();hosted();spec=json.loads(a.spec.read_bytes())
    if a.mode=='economic':run(Path('/out'),Path('/old'),spec)
    else:review(Path('/out'),Path('/evidence'),Path('/old'),spec)
